::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 9th 1894  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection[^1]
:::

Dear [Mrs Holbeach](people/person_706.qmd)
Thank you very much for your sweet story. It is a very happy recollection.

How good of you to send it in the midst of your own care and sorrow

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Envelope addressed to ‘Mrs Holbeach/ Farnborough Hall/ Banbury’.
